events.text: Fixed: dropdown was mounted in the stage viewport so its absolute coords were stage-relative (mid-screen). Moved it to the app root as HW_App's last child (matches every other popover for paint order + hit-test), top under the chrome bar, left derived from real menu-bar geometry. Also removed SSOT kicker + 'capabilities'/wrench slop from the header. sha c7d2d2916

resolution: The File/Edit/... menu dropdown rendered mid-screen because it was mounted inside the stage viewport, making its absolute left/top stage-relative, and menuDropdownLeft clamped against a hardcoded 1536 viewport width. Fixed by moving DropdownMenu to the app root as HW_App's last child (matching every other popover so it paints over the body and hit-tests its pressable rows correctly), setting top to sit flush under the 37px chrome bar, and deriving left from the real Chrome menu-bar geometry (padding + brand + per-item widths/gaps) so each menu's panel lands under its own button. Also removed the header slop: dropped the SSOT kicker, the 'capabilities' filler word, and the decorative wrench icon so the header just names the menu.
